title: Building a template: the canvas row, explanations and file labels
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A checkbox field carrying several follow-ups, some with attached files; view it both selected and not selected.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the field's canvas row lists one line per follow-up: the response name in that response's colour, the first line of the text shortened rather than wrapped, and a clip glyph where a file is attached; and the list renders whether or not the field is selected.
2. Confirm both the section toggle and the acknowledgement toggle are explained on demand via an information affordance, with no permanent panel text.
3. Confirm the always-visible field attachment is labelled 'General reference file' on every field type, while the file inside a follow-up block carries no such label and its control reads 'Attach File'.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A field carrying follow-ups lists one line per follow-up on its canvas row — the response name in that response's colour, the first line of the text shortened rather than wrapped, and a clip glyph where a file is attached — whether or not the field is selected.
  • Both the section toggle and the acknowledgement toggle are explained on demand via an information affordance, with no permanent text on the panel.
  • The always-visible field attachment is labelled "General reference file" on every field type; the file inside a follow-up block carries no such label and its control reads "Attach File".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R10: “The canvas row of a field carrying follow-ups will list one line per follow-up, showing the response name in that response's colour, the first line of the text shortened rather than wrapped, and a clip glyph where a file is attached. The list renders whether or not the field is selected”
  • S19-R11: “Both the section toggle and the acknowledgement toggle will be explained on demand, on an information affordance. Neither will carry permanent text on the panel”
  • S19-R12: “The always-visible field attachment will be labelled "General reference file" on every field type, not only on checkbox. The file inside a follow-up block carries no such label; its control reads "Attach File" as it does everywhere else”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
